findings.issue: The doc says readNodeStore 'skips a torn or malformed line, reports its file and line on stderr'. That holds only for a line that fails to parse as JSON (frontier-admit.cjs:283-287). A line that parses but is not a plain object, or has no nodeId, is skipped with no warning (frontier-admit.cjs:289). Line 38 of the same doc gets this right. Line 42 overstates it.

findings.issue: Command 1 is 'cd .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime && npx vitest run ...'. Commands 2 to 5 then use the repo-root path 'node .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/frontier-admit.cjs'. An operator who runs them in order in one shell is still inside runtime/ after command 1, so commands 2 to 5 fail with module-not-found. The playbook does not say that each command starts from the repo root. Either run command 1 in a subshell or say that each command starts at the repo root.

Same working-directory problem as L7-2. Command 1 cds into .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime. Command 2, 'rg -n ... .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs', uses a repo-root path, so in the same shell it finds no file and prints nothing instead of the expected default of 12 and the two function names (the code itself is at fanout-run.cjs:339, 356 and 677).
